title: Plan
description: A compiled matching plan (spec.md §2). The structured form; the text forms of §3 are what users read and what golden corpora record. A plan is a rendering, not a record — nothing outside this repo stores one, and an engine may compile a different plan for the same input across versions (spec.md §7).

grammar.description: The grammar version this plan is written against — the compatibility surface a component-contributed fragment targets (spec.md §7.1).

variant.description: The variant id this plan was compiled under, when it was compiled under one (design 2.3). Absent means the shape was compiled unpinned.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One node. 'kind' decides which of the carrier members applies; the others are absent.

kind.description: Open vocabulary; an unknown kind is a named failure, never an ignored node (spec.md §4.1).

label.description: For kind 'container': the group label a renderer prints.

name.description: For kind 'action': the action name. Unnamespaced names are reserved for this specification; '<component>:<name>' is contributed (spec.md §4.1).

path.description: For kinds 'resolve' and 'resolve-current': the path resolved against the interaction context, or against the current iteration item.

text.description: For kind 'annotation': the prose. Annotations are not executable.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: A literal carried by a 'value' node: any document-model value (protocol spec §2.4), or an entry (spec.md §2.2). Bytes use the protocol's bytes forms.

of.description: Which kind of value this is. 'entry' is the one plan-only kind.

value.description: The value itself. Carries bytes when tagged (see 'encoded'); untagged it is the natural JSON value.

encoded.description: Representation tag for 'value'. Absent means the natural JSON value; 'base64' means the base64 of an octet sequence (protocol spec §2.4-2.5).

key.description: For 'entry': the key its value is paired with.

Result.title: Result
Result.description: What executing the node produced (spec.md §2.3). A node with no result was not executed — a lazy branch skipped, or an input that never became available.

message.description: For status 'error': what failed, in the words a user reads.

path.description: For status 'error': the path that located the offending value.
